title: 廢金屬渦電流分選~Eddy-current separation of scrap metals
focus: 導電感應、粒子軌跡與非鐵回收~Induction, particle trajectories and non-ferrous recovery
summary: 以「導電感應、粒子軌跡與非鐵回收」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow induction, particle trajectories and non-ferrous recovery through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 非鐵目標與前處理~Non-ferrous targets and pretreatment
units.mechanism: 渦電流分選依導電性產生作用，並不等於傳統鐵磁吸附；先排除鐵件和尺寸極端物。~Eddy-current action depends on conductivity, unlike ferromagnetic attraction; remove ferrous and extreme-size items first.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：target mass=feed*nonferrous fraction;500*0.12；計算 500*0.12 = 60 kg/h。適用限制：假想非鐵質量比例。~Original hypothetical teaching example: target mass=feed*nonferrous fraction;500*0.12; calculation 500*0.12 = 60 kg/h. Applicability: Hypothetical non-ferrous fraction.
units.verify: 把鐵、鋁和塑膠分別標示輸送路徑。~Trace steel, aluminium and plastic paths separately.
units.failure: 鐵件進入高速轉子區可能影響設備與分選。~Ferrous pieces entering the rotor zone can disrupt sorting and equipment.
units.misconception: 渦電流分選就是用磁鐵吸住所有金屬。~Eddy-current sorting simply magnetically attracts every metal.
units.practice: 在「非鐵目標與前處理」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 60 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「鐵件進入高速轉子區可能影響設備與分選。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for non-ferrous targets and pretreatment, first reproduce 60 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Ferrous pieces entering the rotor zone can disrupt sorting and equipment." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 變動磁場與感應~Changing field and induction
units.mechanism: 粒子經歷的磁通變化誘發電流，再與磁場作用改變軌跡；靜止均勻磁場不是同一機制。~Changing magnetic flux induces currents that interact with the field and alter trajectories; a static uniform field differs.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：emf magnitude=N DeltaPhi/DeltaT;N=1;DeltaPhi=0.002Wb;dt=0.01s；計算 1*0.002/0.01 = 0.2 V。適用限制：簡化單迴路感應示例，非粒子完整模型。~Original hypothetical teaching example: emf magnitude=N DeltaPhi/DeltaT;N=1;DeltaPhi=0.002Wb;dt=0.01s; calculation 1*0.002/0.01 = 0.2 V. Applicability: Simple loop example, not a full particle model.
units.verify: 比較磁通變化時間加倍後的感應量級。~Double flux-change time and compare induced voltage.
units.failure: 只看磁場強度而忽略變化率會漏掉感應來源。~Field strength alone misses the role of flux-change rate.
units.misconception: 完全不變的磁通仍會持續誘發同樣電動勢。~Unchanging flux continuously induces the same emf.
units.practice: 在「變動磁場與感應」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.2 V，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只看磁場強度而忽略變化率會漏掉感應來源。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for changing field and induction, first reproduce 0.2 V, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Field strength alone misses the role of flux-change rate." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 導電率與形狀~Conductivity and shape
units.mechanism: 回路電阻受導電率、尺寸與形狀影響；相同金屬質量不代表相同電磁力。~Loop resistance depends on conductivity, size and shape; equal metal mass does not imply equal force.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：R=rho L/A;rho=2.8e-8ohm m;L=0.1m;A=1e-6m2；計算 2.8e-8*0.1/1e-6 = 0.0028 ohm。適用限制：示意鋁導體迴路，不含高頻集膚。~Original hypothetical teaching example: R=rho L/A;rho=2.8e-8ohm m;L=0.1m;A=1e-6m2; calculation 2.8e-8*0.1/1e-6 = 0.0028 ohm. Applicability: Illustrative aluminium loop without skin effects.
units.verify: 比較薄片與團塊的等效迴路。~Compare equivalent loops for flakes and compact pieces.
units.failure: 用金屬名稱單獨預測拋射距離會忽略形狀。~Metal name alone misses shape effects on throw.
units.misconception: 同一材質所有形狀都會飛到同一位置。~Every shape of one material lands at the same point.
units.practice: 在「導電率與形狀」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.0028 ohm，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用金屬名稱單獨預測拋射距離會忽略形狀。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for conductivity and shape, first reproduce 0.0028 ohm, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Metal name alone misses shape effects on throw." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 粒徑分級~Particle-size classification
units.mechanism: 尺寸窄化可減少不同動力學混在同一分料設定；細粒需不同解析能力。~Narrow size classes reduce mixed dynamics under one splitter setting; fines need different resolution.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：size ratio=dmax/dmin;40mm/10mm；計算 40/10 = 4 ratio。適用限制：粒級跨度指標。~Original hypothetical teaching example: size ratio=dmax/dmin;40mm/10mm; calculation 40/10 = 4 ratio. Applicability: Particle-size-span indicator.
units.verify: 將寬粒級分成兩段再比較回收純度。~Split a broad size class and compare recovery purity.
units.failure: 一個分料板位置可能同時漏小粒又夾帶大粒。~One splitter position can miss fines while entraining coarse items.
units.misconception: 全部粒徑混在一起一定比篩分後好分。~All sizes mixed are always easier to separate.
units.practice: 在「粒徑分級」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 4 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「一個分料板位置可能同時漏小粒又夾帶大粒。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for particle-size classification, first reproduce 4 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "One splitter position can miss fines while entraining coarse items." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 輸送速度與自然落點~Belt speed and gravity trajectory
units.mechanism: 先以無電磁作用的拋體落點作基準，再觀察非鐵偏移；空阻和碰撞另列。~Establish a gravity-only baseline before electromagnetic deflection; treat drag and collisions separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：t=sqrt(2h/g);h=0.5m;g=9.81；計算 sqrt(2*0.5/9.81) = 0.319275 s。適用限制：水平離帶、無空阻。~Original hypothetical teaching example: t=sqrt(2h/g);h=0.5m;g=9.81; calculation sqrt(2*0.5/9.81) = 0.319275 s. Applicability: Horizontal release without air drag.
units.verify: 量測塑膠基準落點再加入鋁片。~Measure a plastic baseline landing point before adding aluminium.
units.failure: 沒有自然軌跡基準會把帶速差當電磁差。~Without a baseline belt-speed effects look electromagnetic.
units.misconception: 所有落點差異都只由電磁作用造成。~Every landing-point difference is electromagnetic.
units.practice: 在「輸送速度與自然落點」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.319275 s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「沒有自然軌跡基準會把帶速差當電磁差。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for belt speed and gravity trajectory, first reproduce 0.319275 s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Without a baseline belt-speed effects look electromagnetic." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 分料板位置~Splitter location
units.mechanism: 分料板在純度與回收率間取捨，需看兩群落點分布的重疊。~The splitter trades purity against recovery according to overlapping landing distributions.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：gravity range=v t;v=2m/s;t=0.319275428s；計算 2*0.319275428 = 0.638551 m。適用限制：同前一單元的理想基準。~Original hypothetical teaching example: gravity range=v t;v=2m/s;t=0.319275428s; calculation 2*0.319275428 = 0.638551 m. Applicability: Same ideal baseline as the preceding unit.
units.verify: 逐步移動分料板並記錄兩個產品流質量。~Move the splitter incrementally and weigh both outputs.
units.failure: 只看非鐵回收增加可能漏掉非金屬夾帶。~Higher non-ferrous recovery can hide nonmetal entrainment.
units.misconception: 分料板向外移就能同時無限提高純度與回收。~Moving the splitter outward raises purity and recovery without limit.
units.practice: 在「分料板位置」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.638551 m，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只看非鐵回收增加可能漏掉非金屬夾帶。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for splitter location, first reproduce 0.638551 m, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Higher non-ferrous recovery can hide nonmetal entrainment." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 單層料與碰撞~Monolayer feeding and collisions
units.mechanism: 粒子互撞與重疊可遮蔽電磁作用；送料均勻度決定可重複性。~Collisions and overlap obscure electromagnetic effects; uniform feeding governs repeatability.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：bed loading=mass flow/(belt width*speed);2kg/s/(1m*2m/s)；計算 2/(1*2) = 1 kg/m2。適用限制：平均面載量，未提供粒子厚度。~Original hypothetical teaching example: bed loading=mass flow/(belt width*speed);2kg/s/(1m*2m/s); calculation 2/(1*2) = 1 kg/m2. Applicability: Mean areal loading without particle-thickness estimate.
units.verify: 固定轉子條件，減少送料量比較落點分布。~Keep rotor conditions and reduce feed to compare landing distributions.
units.failure: 過量送料可能讓鋁片被其他物拖住。~Overfeeding can trap aluminium beneath other material.
units.misconception: 送料越厚就一定有越高單機回收率。~A thicker bed always raises recovery.
units.practice: 在「單層料與碰撞」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1 kg/m2，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「過量送料可能讓鋁片被其他物拖住。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for monolayer feeding and collisions, first reproduce 1 kg/m2, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Overfeeding can trap aluminium beneath other material." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 純度與回收率雙指標~Purity and recovery together
units.mechanism: 產品非鐵比例與進料非鐵回收比例有不同分母，應同時報告。~Product non-ferrous fraction and recovered feed-target fraction have different denominators; report both.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：recovery=target recovered/target feed;54/60；計算 54/60 = 0.9 fraction。適用限制：質量基準。~Original hypothetical teaching example: recovery=target recovered/target feed;54/60; calculation 54/60 = 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Mass basis.
units.verify: 若產品總量60kg/h，另算純度並與回收率比較。~For60kg/h total product also calculate purity and compare recovery.
units.failure: 高產品量可能主要是夾帶而非回收更多金屬。~High product output may be entrainment rather than metal recovery.
units.misconception: 產品流量增加就證明分選效率提高。~More product flow proves better separation.
units.practice: 在「純度與回收率雙指標」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.9 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「高產品量可能主要是夾帶而非回收更多金屬。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for purity and recovery together, first reproduce 0.9 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "High product output may be entrainment rather than metal recovery." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 磨耗與間隙漂移~Wear and gap drift
units.mechanism: 皮帶厚度、轉子位置與表面磨耗會改變粒子距磁場的距離；維護需有基準。~Belt thickness, rotor position and wear change particle-field distance; maintenance needs reference measurements.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：relative gap change=(8-6)/6；計算 (8-6)/6 = 0.333333 fraction。適用限制：幾何變化，不推定力的同比關係。~Original hypothetical teaching example: relative gap change=(8-6)/6; calculation (8-6)/6 = 0.333333 fraction. Applicability: Geometric change without proportional-force assumption.
units.verify: 用固定標準樣件比較維護前後落點。~Compare standard-particle landing before/after maintenance.
units.failure: 只依轉速正常判定整機正常可能漏掉間隙變化。~Normal rotor speed can conceal a changed gap.
units.misconception: 轉速不變就代表所有電磁分選條件都不變。~Unchanged rotor speed means all separation conditions are unchanged.
units.practice: 在「磨耗與間隙漂移」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.333333 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只依轉速正常判定整機正常可能漏掉間隙變化。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for wear and gap drift, first reproduce 0.333333 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Normal rotor speed can conceal a changed gap." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 能耗與殘渣價值~Energy and residual value
units.mechanism: 比較同進料組成下每噸電耗和殘渣金屬損失，避免只追求最高轉速。~Compare energy per tonne and metal loss under equal feed composition rather than maximum speed alone.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：specific electricity=power/throughput;15kW/2tonne/h；計算 15/2 = 7.5 kWh/tonne。適用限制：假想完整單機電表。~Original hypothetical teaching example: specific electricity=power/throughput;15kW/2tonne/h; calculation 15/2 = 7.5 kWh/tonne. Applicability: Hypothetical whole-machine meter.
units.verify: 比較兩種轉速的電耗、純度與回收率。~Compare energy, purity and recovery at two speeds.
units.failure: 提高轉速若回收改善小，可能降低整體資源效益。~Higher speed with little recovery gain can worsen resource performance.
units.misconception: 轉速越高永遠越節能。~Higher rotor speed is always more energy efficient.
units.practice: 在「能耗與殘渣價值」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 7.5 kWh/tonne，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「提高轉速若回收改善小，可能降低整體資源效益。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for energy and residual value, first reproduce 7.5 kWh/tonne, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Higher speed with little recovery gain can worsen resource performance." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
